constraints.text: Keep orientation presence/raw/interpretation, WIC automatic application and explicit probe rotation separate. Missing or unreadable metadata is absent/not_readable, never default identity.

Distinguish ICC presence, readability, byte digest, profile application and colour-transform fidelity. BGRA32 conversion is not ICC conversion. Application/fidelity remain NOT_VERIFIED without an independent reference transform.

Metadata is read after full-frame admission and before OnLoad with a positive capture cap. Over-cap profile refuses metadata_cap_exceeded before OnLoad with no output. No metadata-triggered unlimited allocation or fallback decode.

Independent PNG/BMP24/TIFF IFD and strip parser; orientation rotations defined from stored raster; all ROI/metadata pixels compared. WIC output never supplies expectations. No JPEG absolute raster claim.

Fail closed on orientation value relabel, no-effect applied claim, double rotation, source/output dimension changes, ICC digest/presence changes, readability-as-colour-conversion, metadata-unreadable-as-verified, cap-admitted, OnLoad-after-refusal, missing terminal, identity mismatch, unsupported promotion, cancellation promotion, old source/Gate identity.
